qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Sticky retail and SME deposit franchise creates primary-bank switching costs in core cantons, but pricing power is constrained by commoditized mortgage lending and competition from state-backed Cantonal banks.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 4 (CAP = 5, REJECT). Swiss regional retail and SME bank expanding outside core Bernese cantons into competitive markets. Lacks scale, technological differentiation, or pricing power against state-guaranteed Cantonal banks and nationwide institutions, facing secular margin compression in commoditized mortgage lending.
qualitative.evidence: Valiant operates as a regional Swiss retail bank with ROE of ~5.7%, well below cost of equity hurdles. High capital intensity and credit/deposit duration risks without an enduring structural competitive advantage over 15+ years.
